headline: Does giving a camera wings dodge the FCC’s drone ban?
summary: HoverAir is attempting to bypass a US drone ban with its new Versa model. The Versa drone features a unique wing design to potentially sidestep regulations. This move challenges the FCC's December 2025 foreign drone ban.

headline: Nielsen is leaning more on wearables to hear what people are watching
summary: Nielsen plans to use wearable device data to enhance viewership measurement. This initiative aims to improve accuracy in the streaming era. New data capturing enhancements are being added ahead of the fall season.

headline: Google Gemini is getting a dedicated student hub
summary: Google Gemini is launching a new student hub for back-to-school season. The hub offers tools for research, flashcards, and practice quizzes. Study notebooks will now support graphs, images, and test date reminders.

headline: Watch Valve set up the Steam Frame in its own leaked videos
summary: Valve accidentally leaked videos showing the Steam Frame VR headset setup. The unboxing and accessory videos appeared briefly on the ARM Steam client. The Steam Frame is Valve's new virtual-reality headset for game streaming.

headline: Stunning Black Myth: Zhong Kui Gameplay Trailer Gives Us a Closer Look at the New Protagonist, Combat, and a Truly Impressive Parry
summary: Game Science released a 15-minute gameplay trailer for Black Myth: Zhong Kui. The trailer showcases the new protagonist, combat mechanics, and world design. It's a follow-up to the highly anticipated Black Myth: Wukong.

headline: The X-Tech Executive Chair Aims to Upend Premium Models from Herman Miller, Steelcase at a Better Price
summary: The new X-Tech Executive Chair aims to compete with high-end office chairs. It promises premium features at a more affordable price point. The chair targets models from brands like Herman Miller and Steelcase.

headline: Ryan Reynolds Congratulates Christopher Nolan's the Odyssey for Surpassing Deadpool & Wolverine to Become Highest Grossing R-Rated Movie of All Time
summary: Christopher Nolan's "The Odyssey" has become the highest-grossing R-rated film ever. It surpassed "Deadpool & Wolverine" for the box office record. Ryan Reynolds playfully congratulated Nolan on the achievement.

headline: Save $75 Off the Nintendo Switch 2 Plus Up to $130 in Best Buy Credit When You Trade in a Switch Console
summary: Get $75 off the Nintendo Switch 2 with a trade-in offer. Trade in an old Switch console for up to $130 in Best Buy credit. Total savings can reach $205, but retail price increases September 1st.

headline: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK later this month
summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are reportedly moving back to the UK this month. Their children, Archie and Lilibet, are set to start school in September. The couple's return sparks speculation about their future roles.

headline: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but why are they returning to UK now?
summary: Harry and Meghan's sudden decision to return to the UK raises questions. The move follows their history of unexpected announcements. Their return prompts speculation about their relationship with the Royal Family.

headline: Travelodge boss steps down after security issues in rooms
summary: Travelodge CEO Jo Boydell has resigned from her position. Her departure follows criticism over security and safety concerns in rooms. The company faced scrutiny regarding its handling of the issues.

headline: School 'deeply saddened' by death of family in sea off Shoreham
summary: Ellen Wilkinson School expressed deep sadness over the death of Sara El-Khawas and her family. The family tragically died in the sea off Shoreham. The school paid tribute to the 14-year-old student and her relatives.
